terminals.title: Between terminals
terminals.text: Terminals 1 and 2 are about 4 km apart. A free bus runs between Aeroplaza and Terminal 2; the journey takes 7–9 minutes.

storage.title: Baggage storage
storage.text: On Level 4 of Terminal 1 before security, Yamato Transport baggage storage is on the north side and JAL ABC on the south side. Yamato Transport is open from 06:30 to 22:30; JAL ABC is open from 06:30 to 23:00, with the last baggage acceptance at 22:30.

kids.title: Baby rooms
kids.text: Baby rooms can be used by the whole family; the breastfeeding and expressing area is for women only. Rooms have nappy-changing facilities, dedicated nappy bins and hot water for preparing formula; most rooms have microwaves.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: The free network is available in Terminal 1 except on parts of international arrivals routes, at the Terminal 1 bus station and the railway station, in Aeroplaza and Terminal 2. Select #AirportFreeWiFi-Kansai or #AirportFreeWiFi-Kansai2.4G. No advance application is needed, but the terms of use must be accepted. Data between your device and the access point is not encrypted.
